Documents Required for UP Scholarship Pre- Matric and Post Matric Application:- 
 
For Fresh Candidate: 
●​
Last Qualifying Exam Mark Sheet 
●​
Cast Certificate 
●​
Income Certificate 
●​
Bank Passbook 
●​
Mobile Number 
●​
Fee Receipt Number 
●​
Annual Non Refundable Amount 
●​
Enrollment Number 
●​
Aadhar Card Number 
●​
Latest Passport Size Scan Photo 
●​
E-mail id, etc. 
 
For Renewal Candidate: 
Kindly Use Last Year Registration Number to Login to Renewal Section and Enter the Fresh 
Details.
